analysis.summary: Baheti Recycling Industries Limited reported a strong financial performance in H1 FY27, with revenue growing by 67.69% YoY to ₹528.47 crores and PAT surging by 105.83% to ₹19.08 crores. Supported by increasing demand, capacity enhancements, and improved business visibility, management has revised its FY28 revenue guidance upwards to ₹1,300+ crores while maintaining the margin trajectory. The company is actively expanding its Aluminium Wire Rod division in phases on existing land and has received in-principle approval from both NSE and BSE for migration to the Main Boards. Management stated that Baheti Recycling delivered strong financial performance in FY26 with revenue rising to 725 crores and profit reaching 27 crores. The company is expanding its capacity by commencing five new electrical furnaces in FY27, bringing total installed capacity to 38,000 tons annually, and is entering the aluminum wire rod product segment with a new plant in Dahegam.

guidance.claim: Management revised the FY28 revenue guidance upwards from ₹1,100 crores to ₹1,300+ crores while maintaining the existing margin trajectory.
guidance.quote: Accordingly, we have revised our FY28 revenue guidance upwards from ₹1,100 crores to ₹1,300+ crores, while maintaining our existing margin trajectory.

guidance.claim: The company expects to ramp up to full capacity utilization by FY28.
guidance.quote: Our plan is to ramp up utilization, full capacity utilization by FY28.

guidance.claim: Management targets 70% capacity utilization for the wire rod plant in FY28.
guidance.quote: FY28 will be reaching somewhere around 70-odd percentage.

guidance.claim: Management is more than hopeful to reach 4-digit revenue in this financial year alone.
guidance.quote: I'm more than hopeful that we'll reach somewhere around 4-digit in this financial alone.

guidance.claim: Management states that a sustainable EBITDA margin between 7 to 10% is achievable in their industry.
guidance.quote: See, the EBITDA margin in our industry is a sustainable EBITDA margin which we are working on. So anywhere between 7 to 10% is very it's quite sustainable EBITDA margin in our kind of industry

guidance.claim: Management expects to target top 3 or 4 aluminum alloy manufacturers in India by FY28.
guidance.quote: and now, as we are approaching towards OEMs, so in next one year or two, FY28, we can we can target ourselves into top 3 or 4 aluminum alloy manufacturer, number one.

guidance.claim: The company surpassed its stated revenue guidance for FY26 by 12%.
guidance.quote: FY26 has been a good year for us. We closed the year having surpassed our stated revenue guidance by 12%, with PAT growth coming in at over 15% against what we had guided for.

guidance.claim: The company is confidently positioned to exceed a revenue milestone of ₹1,200 crores by FY28.
guidance.quote: We are confidently positioned to exceed a Revenue milestone of ₹1,200Cr by FY28

demand_outlook.claim: The upward revision in revenue guidance is driven by improved business visibility and opportunities across existing and upcoming product segments.
demand_outlook.quote: This upward revision is due to improved business visibility and the opportunities we see across our existing and upcoming product segments.

demand_outlook.claim: Increasing demand, capacity enhancements, and a growing presence across key industries have strengthened growth confidence over past quarters.
demand_outlook.quote: Over the past few quarters, our confidence in the Company's growth prospects has strengthened, supported by increasing demand, capacity enhancements and a growing presence across key industries.

demand_outlook.claim: Management reports that the recycling industry environment is currently favorable due to disrupted global primary aluminum supply.
demand_outlook.quote: The recycling industry environment is favorable right now. Global primary aluminum supply has been disrupted, particularly from the geopolitical tension going on in the Middle East, and that is pushing customer everywhere towards reliable secondary sources.

demand_outlook.claim: Management states that demand is strong and government policy tailwinds exist for secondary recycling aluminum.
demand_outlook.quote: We are bullish on the sector and on our position in it. The demand is that the government policy tailwinds are there, the global industry dynamics are in favor of secondary recycling aluminium.

demand_outlook.claim: Management notes huge demand for aluminum wire rods in the growing industry.
demand_outlook.quote: Aluminum wire rod, if I talk about aluminum wire rod, aluminum wire rod is a good industry. It is an upbringing industry and the demand is huge in aluminum wire.

demand_outlook.claim: Confirmed order book stands at over ₹175 crores as the company steps into Q1 FY27.
demand_outlook.quote: As we step into Q1 FY27, our confirmed order book already stands at over ₹175 Crores, a reflection of the steady demand for secondary aluminium domestically and the trust our clients continue to place in us.

demand_outlook.claim: Disruptions in the Middle East have tightened primary aluminium supply globally.
demand_outlook.quote: Disruptions in the Middle East have tightened primary aluminium supply globally, and the pressure on availability is real.

capex_expansion.claim: The Aluminium Wire Rod division is expanding capacity on existing owned land in two phases with a total intended capacity of 25,000 MT.
capex_expansion.quote: A key priority for us is the expansion of our Aluminium Wire Rod division, where we are expanding our capacity on our existing owned land in two phases. Over time, we intend to have a total wire-rod capacity of 25,000 MT, representing a revenue opportunity of approximately ₹500 crores annually.

capex_expansion.claim: Two pairs of Tilting & Rotary Furnaces (TRF) with Skelner of 40MTPD Installed Capacity each were commissioned in FY26, with pit furnaces discarded.
capex_expansion.quote: We have expanded our machinery portfolio by adding two pairs of TRF with Skelner of 40MTPD Installed Capacity each and discarding our pit Furnaces.

capex_expansion.claim: A capex of ₹10 crores per furnace was incurred to strengthen manufacturing capabilities.
capex_expansion.quote: CAPEX of ₹10Cr. per furnace per paid incurred to strengthen our manufacturing capabilities.

capex_expansion.claim: The company is ready to commence 5 new electrical furnaces in FY27.
capex_expansion.quote: As part of this, we are now ready to commence 5 new electrical furnaces in FY27.

capex_expansion.claim: The company is investing around 25 crores to build out the aluminum wire rod product in two phases on existing freehold land in Dahegam.
capex_expansion.quote: We are investing somewhere around 25-odd crores to build this out in two phases on our existing freehold land in Dahegam

capex_expansion.claim: Phase 1 of the wire rod plant targets around 12,500 metric tons per annum with an annual revenue potential of 250 crores.
capex_expansion.quote: We are targeting in Phase 1 around 12,500 metric ton per annum, with an annual revenue potential of 250-odd crores

capex_expansion.claim: Phase 2 of the wire rod plant will increase capacity to 25,000 tons and double the revenue potential to 500 crores.
capex_expansion.quote: In phase 2, it will increase to 25,000 tons. That, that means the revenue will also increase by another 250 odd crores. So, total revenue from this plant will be somewhere around 500 odd crores.

capex_expansion.claim: Phase 2 of the wire rod project will require a maximum of 5 crores for the furnace and infrastructure.
capex_expansion.quote: Phase 2 would be 5 crores maximum in putting up the furnace and all. Other apart from it, the major cost consists that of infrastructure, so we are developing infrastructure on the basis of the entire phases.

capex_expansion.claim: The company is investing ₹20-25 crores in FY27 to build out the Aluminium Wire Rod division on existing freehold land.
capex_expansion.quote: On the capacity side, we are putting ₹20–25 Crores to work in FY27 to build out our Aluminium Wire Rod division on our existing freehold land.

capex_expansion.claim: Phase 1 of the Aluminium Wire Rod division targets 12,500 MT capacity.
capex_expansion.quote: Phase 1 targets 12,500 MT, which we expect to generate between ₹200–250 Crores in annual revenue.

capex_expansion.claim: Phase 2 scales capacity to 25,000 MT with a revenue potential reaching ₹500 crores a year.
capex_expansion.quote: When we scale to 25,000 MT in Phase 2 in forthcoming years, the revenue potential from this division alone reaches ₹500 Crores a year.

capex_expansion.claim: Five more electric furnaces are lined up for commissioning in FY27.
capex_expansion.quote: Alongside this, we have been replacing our older pit furnaces with more Electric Furnaces, taking our total smelting capacity to 38,000 MT, and five more furnaces are lined up for FY27.

capex_expansion.claim: The captive solar plant is expected to be running by the end of May 2026.
capex_expansion.quote: Our captive solar plant should be running by end of May 2026 and this directly cuts our power costs on the electric furnaces, and the margin benefit will start showing up from Q2 onwards.

margins_costs.claim: Revenue from operations grew by 67.69% YoY to ₹528.47 crores, EBITDA increased by 99.48% to ₹42.37 crores, and PAT grew by 105.83% to ₹19.08 crores in H1 FY27.
margins_costs.quote: Revenue from operations grew by 67.69% YoY to ₹528.47 crores, while EBITDA increased by 99.48% to ₹42.37 crores and PAT grew by 105.83% to ₹19.08 crores.

margins_costs.claim: Entering the aluminum wire rod product segment will improve EBITDA margins by 1 or 2% from the existing business.
margins_costs.quote: The EBITDA margin will improve by 1 or 2% from the existing business.

margins_costs.claim: Cost of production increased by 15% due to fuel prices.
margins_costs.quote: See, the cost of production has increased, no doubt about it, because of the fuel prices, the cost of production has increased by 15%.

margins_costs.claim: Secondary aluminum is cheaper than primary aluminum by 7 to 10% in terms of aluminum alloy.
margins_costs.quote: See, in terms of aluminum alloy, the primary and secondary aluminum difference ranges between 7 to 10 %, and secondary aluminum is cheaper as compared to primary aluminum.

margins_costs.claim: The captive solar plant will directly cut power costs on electric furnaces with margin benefits starting from Q2.
margins_costs.quote: Our captive solar plant should be running by end of May 2026 and this directly cuts our power costs on the electric furnaces, and the margin benefit will start showing up from Q2 onwards.
